notes:
- Send a suggestion or request to the developer from Help or Settings; you see exactly what is sent, and your e-mail address goes only if you allow it
- Several computers on a local network: one USB is the host with the data, others connect to it as clients (encrypted, no internet); devices pair with a 6-digit code and a fingerprint check; each person signs in with an own username and permissions
- Summary cards at the top of the home page in every theme: total receivable, total payable, net balance and today's collections
- Color palettes: 19 palettes (including 3 soft light greys) for menus, cards, buttons, tables and forms, each with light and dark tones; the accent color can still be chosen
- New theme "Office": a wide sidebar with the auto-lock countdown and the user card, search on top
- Existing data on an unencrypted disk no longer opens: the program asks for the disk to be encrypted first (BitLocker on Windows); the data is not deleted and opens again once the disk is encrypted
- 10 more logos to choose from (20 in all): calculator, receipt, briefcase, safe, key, globe, anchor, gem, calendar, layers
- A host serving the network locks only its screen after 1 minute without activity (password to continue, connected devices keep working); the session closes after 10 minutes
- Screens use their space better: one-line page headers, compact filters, the less common "New" buttons under "More"
- A demo notice at the top of every screen and in the status bar
